'''Subject 13 Confinement''' was a [[Rakata/Legends|Rakatan]] vault located in the [[Cells of the Lords of the Infinite]] in the [[the Tomb]], an ancient [[Prison/Legends|prison]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]]. It contained the [[mind prison]] in which [[Subject 13]] was kept prisoner, and during the [[invasion of Belsavis]], the Sith Empire attempted to free Subject 13.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Subject 13 Confinement appears as a location on Belsavis in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', and is the site of the Imperial mission "Subject 13."<ref name="TOR" />
